name: Landa
summary: Near-black green-tinted SaaS landing with aqua glow arcs, wireframe isometric icons and quiet Inter type; the dark-tech template done with restraint.

fonts.pairing: one variable grotesk; 550 for headlines with -2% tracking, 400-450 for body, hierarchy from size and opacity only

signature: planet-horizon glow arcs (aqua rim light over a dark dome) used as section openers for pricing and CTA
dotted-wireframe isometric 3D glyphs inside dark bento feature cards with a faint colour wash per card
giant cropped brand wordmark rendered as a glitchy light-streak texture above the footer
imagery: no photography; diagonal aqua light streaks with halftone grain, wireframe isometric objects, product UI mocks (optimisation checklist, bar chart dashboard)
layout_grid: 1440 canvas, ~1078px content (181px side padding), 112px section padding, 2x2 bento then 3-up and 4-up rows
